subject.title: Slack: Show tool-level progress in assistant thread status

question: Should Slack native assistant-thread status show sanitized per-tool progress, or should it remain generic while loading messages, draft previews, status reactions, and task cards carry progress visibility?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the best behavior depends on Slack UX, disclosure policy, duplicate progress surfaces, and possible config/default choices rather than a narrow broken-code repair.

options.title: Decide With Visibility Policy
options.body: Keep this issue open and decide it together with the Slack-safe progress visibility policy before adding native per-tool status labels.

options.title: Implement Sanitized Native Status
options.body: Add deduped per-tool native status updates from the shared sanitized progress model, with final clearing, focused tests, and live Slack proof.

options.title: Keep Native Status Generic
options.body: Document that Slack native assistant status stays generic and progress should use loading messages, draft previews, status reactions, or task cards instead.

recommendation.title: Decide With Visibility Policy
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and decide it together with the Slack-safe progress visibility policy before adding native per-tool status labels.
